questions: Do recent measured performance signals help explain the next race beyond older ability records?
Does past body-mass history add information beyond recent records?
Which existing pre-race source candidates are available?
population: Immutable weight source52,155 strict complete normal starts,7-13 runners. Targets require>=5 prior exact-distance valid history starts, and >=3 target runners eligible per race. All models evaluated on identical target rows.
availability: Target features use only same official ID history with event date<=target date-2days. No current-race body, result, moisture, burden, gate, grade, sex or age. Target exact distance and calendar assumed scheduled metadata; past event sex/age retained. Stored historical results may reflect later revisions; event-date restriction does not prove original publication. No future/full-career body median.
features_A: Older same-distance ability: median and mean of last up-to10 history excluding latest2; count, rest since last exact-distance event, last historical burden and grade and sex and event age; target-month two harmonics, historical-grade/sex categorical. Histories can precede2017.
features_B: A plus latest time, mean latest2 and5, slope and SD and best of latest5, recent-minus-older difference. This is performance-form proxy, not measured physiological condition; recent records also capture evolving ability and prior track conditions.
features_C: A plus body features from last up-to6 eligible strict observed starts at any current distance: latestkg, median, SD, latest-minus-earlier median, last endpoint delta and percentage, history count and staleness. Historical body source starts2017; missing kept, not healthy/zero.
features_D: B plus same body features. Main body increment D-versus-B; C-versus-A secondary. No stage trained on future data.
estimator: Separate exact distance Ridge alpha10. Numeric median imputation with missing indicators, standardization, one-hot pastgrade/pastsex handling unknown. Train races all years<=evaluationyear-1, target years2024,2025,2026partial; no tuning. Minimum training500rows/50dates/50horses; minimum evaluation100rows/20dates/30horses. Identical sample across4models.
metrics: Absolute next-time MAE and RMSE with equal race weight. Within-race centered-time MAE secondary removes common race error for evaluation only. Per-year and2024-2025combined/2026partial. Paired improvement positive=lower error. Date-cluster plus horse-cluster variance without intersection subtraction, t smaller cluster count; same data repeated development, not independent validation.
persistence_diagnostic: Prior form = latest exact-distance time minus median older history excludinglatest2, >=5history. Good<=-0.5s,poor>=+0.5s,middleotherwise fixed before outcomes; not diagnostic cutoffs. Compare future A forecast errors centered within target race and pair good-versus-poor differences, date+horse uncertainty. Past rest bins<=30,31-60,61-120,>120days for B-A increment. Association not physical state persistence.
inventory_only: Existing daily training duration/observed-days, medical raw events, starting-training remarks are candidates. Read scope/contracts first. Count past28-day available event-date records through T-2 by exactID; event/publication distinction. Medical absent means unknown, run-count0 unavailable, missingduration not0. No new training/medical coefficients estimated or adopted.
multiplicity: BH paired comparison p across supported distances for each period/contrast/metric. Exploratory group means not significance screened; good-minus-poor BH across distances by period.
